text: good place for good price. Everything you need in the room is minimal, the furniture is quite old. but there is a swimming pool and a balcony Air-conditioner for extra price. Internet is slow and coverage is poor. the kitchen is poorly equipped for cooking

I didn’t like it, won’t stay again. Great location and very nice the people how helped with breakfast and the cleaning people. The bed was confortable and the size of the room is fine! The rugs in the room felt dirty. Didn’t smell clean. When the bathroom light was on the vent was on, you couldn’t turn the light on without turning on the super nosy vent. When we turn the vent on I could smell the weed of someone smoking. You could hear EVERYTHING next door. They were the worst room neighbors ever!!!!! The breakfast was poor. The gym was depressing, so I went running outside better. They change towels and take out garbage from rooms but they don’t make the room, they don’t make the bed or clean anything else.
We loved it. Kettle in the room. Checkout at noon. Bath! , Not a shower as well. 6 min walking from the station The people in the corridor were loud very early in the morning.

Not sure where the high rating comes from but makes me wonder what all the other hotels are like that had a lower rating. Close proximity to everything we were interested in. It was quiet and the windows opened for fresh air. The room could have been better. There were stains on the floor and the tub was clean but didn’t look it as it had stains on it from a rough texture that hadn’t been cleaned properly in the past. The place could use a renovation- new rugs, tubs and a general update. The breakfast was good but a choice of some fresh fruit would have made it that much better.

Super close to the bus stop to the airport and train station, so a big bonus there. Not sure if I could have found a smaller room in Santiago, but it was for one night and I was travelling alone for work. No big deal. The bed wasn't very comfortable and only one super thin pillow was provided. It was warm and night, but I did find a fan in the closet.
TOO EARLY FOR BREAKFAST

I’d like to stay here if i ever come back to switzerland alone. centrally located, amazing views, great staff and good breakfast menu. only problem was rooms get congested with 7 beds. Only washroom within the room, baths are common. the floor squeaks and it’s very annoying.
Excellent buffet, spacious rooms. The cigarette smoke infiltrating the gym was gross. Pool wasn’t that appealing.

Really nice, clean bathroom and nice overall room. The location was perfect, right in the middle of the city with FREE parking which nowadays in Bulgaria is unheard of. Breakfast was lame, honestly for a boutique hotel you cannot serve such a basic breakfast. Sure the cake was nice but I want some bacon, I want some eggs, I want things to be cooked so I can choose from. The only extra was the mini frying pan where they offered to make you an omlet. And the ham that was given was the cheapest ham that you can buy from the store that tastes like rubber with some salt on. Either get rid of the breakfast completely or just change it.

Super convenient location with lots of dining options nearby and the facilities were clean and well maintained. Nothing big but I wish the beds had more pillows and thicker and/or extra blankets. Driving up the parking deck was very dizzying and tight to drive up.

Santiago central. Very helpful reception staff and spacious room with tea /coffee making facilities. Booking.com quoted 160e for a twin room for 2 nights. In fact we were charged 191.15e. An extra 73e remain blocked.
Nice hotel. Check in easy. Very helpful man who booked us in, Room spotless and very quiet. Cooked breakfast was very poor. Bacon not nice and i was informed they don,t do fried eggs

Absolutely made the right choice with this location! The room was mostly clean(except for a small issue in the bathroom, which really did not take away from the comfort and enjoyment of the say). I wanted a room with a view and I was not disappointed at all! Location was very convenient to the main street and the inn was clean and peaceful. Would recommend! As mentioned previously, There was a small issue in the bathroom. The inn uses liquid soap/body wash, however someone, i assume on a previous stay, had used a hard soap and it was left in the soap tray. The cleaning staff did not dispose of the soap therefore I was left to assume that the bathroom was not properly cleaned. Honestly I stayed for two nights and did not alert the staff about it until check out because it really did not impact my vacation.

Our stay was too short ( in at almost 6pm and out at 4 AM next day). We didn’t have time. Reception staff was very helpful. Property was very modern. Public space huge; rooms roomy . No information as to how to turn shower on . I had to call down to ask. So unusual. Turn on, turn off then pull up. Services had to be accessed by scanning . What if the guest doesn’t have a mobile?

Location. Pool. Restaurant by pool. Room decor. Secured access to lift lobbies and rooms. Breakfast restaurant staffs very kind and helpful. Filtered water available in room kitchen. Reception staffs not welcoming. Room service you need to chase them every two days. Toilet seat was broken when checked in, it was still not fixed when checked out. Room was filthy; dust everywhere, kitchenware dirty, microwave dirty and bathroom smelling mold, under hand bassin cabinet is full of mold. Shower head too high and need maintenance, water goes outside the shower too much. You get all toiletries, but bring your own hand soap.
Would definately return. Great location, friendly staff, clean room, great value for money. Beds were a bit too firm for me but that’s personal preference.

it was very convenient and I will be staying there again definitely. It is very convenient, so close to the airport, great staff. I will definitely stay there again, but it was quite cold on the night I stayed. Had been told the radiator would come on at some time in the night, but it didn't and it really was just very cold.

Comfy stay. The hotel is located in the city center of Kuantan which makes it very convenient to travel to shopping malls, restaurants and even tourist hot spots. I booked the deluxe triple room and it was spacious. There could be more variation of food choices for the breakfast buffet provided. Also, there is no hairdryer in the room, should consider providing hairdryers for all rooms.
Breakfast was very good. Location near Opera House and several excellent restaurants. Room was small. Curtain didn’t cover window.

If you want historic ambience, quirky charm and staff and manager who can’t do enough to help as well as unrivalled view. Amazing views, friendly and helpful staff, view from the rooms, the wonderful General Manager, Lovely breakfast and charming ambience and a peaceful retreat from the business of town. A little chilly and the dinner menu could be a little more imaginative…. Also the advertised bar was closed due to license renewal which was unfortunate over Christmas.
Very decent stay in Saginaw. Friendly staff, clean establishment, comfortable bed, late check-out option for a fee, central location. Broken vending machines, confusing layout, loud room parties.

The lodge was nice and had air conditioning That you have to sit in the kitchen for breakfast and also when checking out there was no one at the reception yet the check out time is 10 am and i check out at 9 45
Cleanness and also the receptionist also good location There is no carpet in the room so I like that always smells good
Cute staff, fire chats, big and high ceiling room. Next to a big road so you might hear engine noise. Make sure to have ear plugs :)
On the details. Decoration, details and staff. We had a late check in but we had the key ready after we scanned the qr code.

Great stay. Spacious, well-appointed property. Comfortable beds and pillows. Plenty of room and seating to allow 3-4 adults to be perfectly comfortable. Great location! The only reason I didn’t rate as a 10 was because we couldn’t get the shower water in either bathroom regulated well - - especially the front bath. As a result, water was quite warm,, but we managed by taking very quick showers. Otherwise it was wonderful and a delightful stay. Hot water in showers mentioned above

pleasent 3 day break. Very clean and modern apartment which is close to Jewish quarter and 20 walk to the square and new town. Quiet area too so no problem with noise. On arriving at airport my advice is to get an Uber as it is much cheaper than anything else. Would definitely come back and stay again in same apartment. only thing that I’d say is make sure the people arriving get notified that the apartment is not called golden apartments but GA luxury apartments. As we found out we took an Uber and was taken to a different location 2 miles away so had to get another taxi.

4 nights in Istanbul. Hotel Location was extremely good Staff were extremely helpful n friendly The view from my room was great (facing the Bosphorus) Room was a bit small Shower was extremely small No lifts (my room on the 3rd floor)
A nice clean room, very friendly staff, 24 hour reception, free parking, a decent restaurant, price is reasonable and they even sell necessities and snacks in the foyer.what's not to like?
Useful location Clean Shower - leaked from all direction when in use
